full_judgment:
Md. Ismailuddin Sarker J: The tenant-petitioner filed this application for leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated 13-6-1995 passed by a learned Judge of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.280 of 1992 affirming judgment and decree dated 30-4-1994 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Third Court-cum-SCC Judge, Dhaka in SCC Case No.12 of 1991 decreeing the suit for ejectment of the petitioner. 

 4. The learned SCC Judge after hearing both the parties and considering the evidence on record decreed the suit for eviction by his judgment and decree dated 30-4-1992. The petitioner thereafter moved the High Court Division under section 25 of the Small Cause Courts Act and obtained a Rule. The learned Judge of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order dated 13-6-1995 discharged the Rule affirming the judgment and order passed by the learned SCC Judge.
